programme.title: Ainsley's Good Mood Food

programme.title: Cooking with the Stars

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott explores the rich and aromatic flavours of South Asia, with his first dish being vada pav, a speciality from Mumbai consisting of a spicy fluffy potato patty that is battered and fried and served up with a selection of chutneys. Lisa Snowdon meets the team at Mr Bombay to find out about the tasty treats they serve up to marketgoers and cooks a lamb curry, while actress Donna Preston makes a vegetarian dish of spiced paneer skewers with mango salad

programme.title: Assault

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Join Caroline Munro as she takes a glimpse at the supernatural thrills and perplexing mysteries featuring next week.

programme.title: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: 1987. Crime. Directed by Mike Hodges. Stars Mickey Rourke, Bob Hoskins & Alan Bates. An IRA hitman wants out, but the price for his freedom is one last job and it won't be as easy as he thinks.

programme.title: The Moderns
programme.desc: 1988. Drama. Director: Alan Rudolph. Stars Keith Carradine, Linda Fiorentino & Wallace Shawn. In 1920s Paris, a struggling artist's life takes an unexpected turn when he agrees to forge paintings.

programme.title: It Happened In Soho
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Director: Frank Chisnell. Stars Richard Murdoch, Patricia Raine & Henry Oscar. Murder drama set in Soho involving a police inspector, a newspaper reporter and a country girl.

programme.title: Look At Life Gibraltar's New Day
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the British Overseas Territory that has been a British Outpost since 1704, now taking a look at the island as it transforms into a holiday destination.

programme.title: Beau Geste
programme.desc: Episode Five. 1982. Stars Benedict Taylor, John Forgeham & John Rumney. Boldini informs Lejaune that Michael has a stolen jewel on him. Lejaune persuades Bolidar, a former pickpocket, to steal it.

programme.title: Gorgo
programme.desc: 1961. Sci-Fi. An undersea earthquake causes some sea-monsters to surface. Gorgo is captured and taken to be displayed in London, but Gorgo's mother is looking for her baby. Starring Bill Travers.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed at the end of August and beginning of September.

programme.title: Space Patrol
programme.desc: The Planet of Thought. 1963. Stars Libby Morris, Murray Kash & Dick Vosburgh. Tyro arrives on Earth planning to join the UGO but is sidetracked when he catches sight of Marla.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Puzzles are Coming. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. The Puzzler tries to fool Knab while the Dynamic Duo hunt the truth, but The Puzzler plans to stop their search.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Vision Fades. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Jeremy Bisley & Roger Bizley. Victory close and Jerusalem in sight, Richard readies for battle but realises his allies are undependable.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Sunken Temple. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Greydon Gould. Despite warnings from locals, the Supercar team explore an underwater temple only to find out why they were warned.

programme.title: The Secret Tunnel
programme.desc: 1948. Family. Directed by William C. Hammond. Stars: Tony Wager, Ivor Bowyer, Murray Matheson. Two boys set out to bring justice to the thieves of a Rembrandt painting.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: A Guest for The Gallows. 1955. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. For obvious reasons, Robin and the Sheriff are sworn enemies. Why then should the Sheriff seek Robin's help?

programme.title: 12 to the Moon
programme.desc: 1960. Sci-fi. Directed by David Bradley. Stars Ken Clark, Michi Kobi & Tom Conway. An international team embarks on an expedition to the moon where they encounter a dangerous alien intelligence.

programme.title: Look At Life Flight Deck
programme.desc: 1960. A look at how the aircraft carrier is now the central part of naval operations, with an appearance of the carrier Hermes on exercise.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: Doomsday. 1959. Stars Donald Harron, Torin Thatcher, Patricia Michon. A young girl, condemned to death as a witch after the natural death of her lover, places a curse on the family of her accuser.

programme.title: Paratrooper
programme.desc: 1954. War. Director: Terence Young. Stars Leo Genn, Alan Ladd & Harry Andrews. Distraught over his role in a tragic training accident, a US Air Force officer secretly enlists in the British Army.

programme.title: Douglas Fairbanks Presents
programme.desc: A Line in the Snow. 1954. Stars Robert Beatty & Patrick Holt. Mountie Warren wanted his man at any price but how could he leave a man to die in a blizzard, even though he was guilty of murder?

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1954. The Blazing Caravan. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Edgar Driver, Alan Robinson & Betty Carter. A Salesman turns murderer after learning that his client has just won the football pools. (S1, E04)

programme.title: Albert R.N.
programme.desc: 1953. Directed by Lewis Gilbert. Starring Jack Warner, Robert Beatty and Anthony Steel. With the help of a life-like dummy, Allied forces are escaping a POW camp. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: On Holiday. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Bernard Kaye, Nanette Newman & Perlita Neilson. Maigret's wife is hospitalised whilst on holiday, which leads him to investigate a crime to pass the time.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. Into The Dark. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Philip is brought into a desert hospital blinded. John considers suicide and Margaret makes her choice. (S2, E14)

programme.title: The Key
programme.desc: 1958. War. Director: Carol Reed. Stars William Holden, Sophia Loren, Trevor Howard. A tugboat captain working off the coast of England finds comfort in the arms of the caring and beautiful Stella.

programme.title: The File of the Golden Goose
programme.desc: 1969. Thriller. Directed by Sam Wanamaker. Stars Yul Brynner, Charles Gray & Edward Woodward. A U.S. agent and a Scotland Yard detective team up to infiltrate an infamous counterfeit organisation.

programme.title: The Agitator
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Director: John Harlow. Stars William Hartnell, Mary Morris & John Laurie. In this 'lost' William Hartnell film, a socialist inherits the British factory where he works as a union mechanic

programme.title: Look A Life In The Swim
programme.desc: 1960. An investigative look at the tropical fish industry; where do they come from and where do they go?

programme.title: The Sword of Monte Cristo
programme.desc: 1951. Adventure. Stars George Montgomery, Rita Corday & Berry Kroeger. Set in 19th Century France, The country's conniving chief minister will stop at nothing to gain possession of the sword.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Bee Skeps/Flooded River Fishing. 1978. This specially preserved episode shows a traditional bee skep being made. Then, planning to fish in a stream on Salisbury Plain, Jack finds it in flood.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: 1962. Drama directed by Francis Searle and starring Dermot Walsh. When a young girl is knocked down there are only three donors of the same blood group. A frantic search to find the donors begins.

programme.title: Not So Dusty
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy directed by Maclean Rogers. Two dustmen (Bill Owen and Leslie Dwyer) come into possession of a valuable book but the donor's sister wants it back. Also starring Joy Nichols.

programme.title: The Fly
programme.desc: 1958. Sci-fi Horror. Director: Kurt Neumann. Stars David Hedison, Vincent Price & Patricia Owens. A keen scientist has a horrifying accident when he tests his newly invented teleportation device.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed Pays His Income Tax. 1963. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Irene Ryan & John Stephenson. Mr Drysdale tells an IRS agent the story of the Clampetts and how they got to be where they are today.

programme.title: The Stranger Wore a Gun

programme.title: Pompon An Béirín Beag

programme.title: Rita

programme.title: Pip & Posy

programme.title: Scoil Bheag Helen

programme.title: True agus Ríocht an Bhogha Ceatha

programme.title: Ainmhithe Craiceáilte

programme.title: Comhrá
